title: Blue Hearts
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Yuuhi Nagi is halfway through high school with no friends, no goals and failing grades. He is grouped with other students at risk of being held back and one classmate who tutors them, and the five form an unlikely bond as each one's hidden troubles come out (Pocket Comics blurb via AniList; MAL reviews). Full-color webtoon by the creator of ReLIFE.
life_message: Nobody has to carry their burdens alone; friendship can pull people back from despair.

content.note: Violence and delinquents; attempted gang assault (MAL reviews list violence; AniList Delinquents; MU Attempted Gang Rape).
Tragedy and suicide crisis scenes amid comedy (AniList Tragedy; reviews).
